FN-SOBM55-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 320
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/16/2023
Senate Bill 320 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Forensic
Sciences, paid from the DNA Database Fund, to test and catalog fingerprints and DNA samples
taken of illegal aliens in the custody of local law enforcement agencies prior to release from
custody. The amount of the Department's increased obligation is undetermined, but would be
dependent upon the number of DNA samples that would be required to be tested and cataloged
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.

FN-SOBM55-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 320
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/17/2023
Senate Bill 320 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase the obligations of the
Department of Forensic Sciences, paid from the DNA Database Fund, to test and catalog DNA
samples taken of illegal aliens in the custody of local law enforcement agencies prior to release
from custody. The amount of the Department's increased obligation is undetermined, but would
be dependent upon the number of DNA samples that would be required to be tested and
cataloged pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to catalog fingerprints of illegal aliens submitted by local law enforcement
agencies.

FN-SOBM55-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 320
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/30/2023
Senate Bill 320 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Department of
Forensic Sciences, paid from the DNA Database Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent
on the cost to test and catalog DNA samples taken from illegal aliens in the custody of local law
enforcement agencies.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to catalog fingerprints of illegal aliens.
This bill could also increase the obligations of local law enforcement agencies by an
undetermined amount to collect DNA and fingerprints of illegal aliens in the custody of the
agency.

FN-SOBM55-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 320
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/31/2023
Senate Bill 320 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security could
increase the obligations of the Department of Forensic Sciences, paid from the DNA Database
Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to test and catalog DNA samples taken
from illegal aliens in the custody of local law enforcement agencies.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency to catalog fingerprints of illegal aliens.
This bill could also increase the obligations of local law enforcement agencies by an
undetermined amount to collect DNA and fingerprints of illegal aliens in the custody of the
agency.
Finally, this bill would increase receipts to the DNA Database Fund, assessed in certain cases,
by increasing the court fee from $11, under current law, to $14, beginning in fiscal year 2024.
